insight: Sells exclusively via custom enterprise contracts with seat minimums and no public pricing — and counts 60+ AmLaw 100 firms as customers.
name: Harvey
tagline: Domain-specific AI for legal and professional services.
description: Harvey is an AI platform built for law firms and corporate legal teams to research, analyze documents, and draft. It pairs an assistant and a secure document vault with purpose-built agents that execute complex legal work end to end. Sold through enterprise contracts rather than self-serve.

modelSupport.notes: Built on frontier foundation models from multiple labs, tuned for legal work.
